deterministicFindings.title: Inventory wire shape omits status/history metadata that the page treats as established zero or Never run
deterministicFindings.mechanism: List creates automationResponse from the base Automation only; response adds optional next_fire_time/conflicts but supplies no auto_disabled, execution_count, failure_count or last_triggered_at. TypeScript declares these required, without runtime validation. Undefined auto_disabled is falsy, so auto-disabled count/filter/banner act as if measured zero; card counters use ??0 and undefined last_triggered_at renders Never run. Actual supplied metadata cannot establish those assertions.
deterministicFindings.sourceConfirmedEffect: For the currently inspected serializer, every loaded row lacks the stated execution/auto-disable fields. Runs 0/Never run and auto-disabled total 0 are unsupported conclusions, even though base enabled-state counts remain derivable.
deterministicFindings.followUpScope: Parent coordinate one shared list DTO/hook/type owner with the separately assigned singular-list owner. Define actually available metadata versus unknown and adapt this page/card presentation; do not add fabricated historical counters or inspect/rework the other page in this queue item.
deterministicFindings.runtimeLimit: No live response or actual execution history observed.

deterministicFindings.title: Embedded comfort editor contradicts read-only mode and config save lacks the client live-only gate
deterministicFindings.mechanism: Page displays an automation read-only notice, but ComfortPanel consumes no operational mode and disables Save/Precondition only while pending. PUT /comfort/config does not set requiresLiveMode; assertOperationalWriteAllowed returns early without that flag, and offline unsafe patterns include /comfort/now but not /comfort/config. Precondition now does retain its request-layer guard.
deterministicFindings.sourceConfirmedEffect: In an online as_of session, the config-save request has no inspected client mode gate, despite read-only page chrome. Offline config save also lacks that explicit guard. The immediate-now UI looks enabled but its request is refused in non-live mode.
deterministicFindings.followUpScope: ComfortPanel/useComfort owner align editor/Save/Now enabled and reason states with existing operational mode and explicitly decide the config-write policy. Preserve existing immediate actuation guard and selected vehicle; no global write-policy weakening.
deterministicFindings.runtimeLimit: No backend write, Tesla command, or guard bypass executed. Global mutation defaults are always/retry0, so this finding is not a claim of delayed replay.

deterministicFindings.title: Typed import reports success without exposing per-entry failures and declares the wrong response shape
deterministicFindings.mechanism: Server importResult is imported: importedAutomation[] and optional errors: importError[]. It returns 201 when at least one import succeeds, even if other entries fail. Hook declares imported?:number/skipped?:number and ignores the onSuccess payload, emitting only Automations imported. Page delegates network outcome to that toast and offers no partial-result detail.
deterministicFindings.sourceConfirmedEffect: The inspected mixed-result path is classified as success and its entry-specific failures are discarded by the client presentation.
deterministicFindings.followUpScope: Assigned page import/hook DTO owner consume real imported/errors arrays and expose partial result with narrow retry guidance. Retain CTI rejection, file reset, and live-only guard. Fixture's accepted version 2 is only mocked client behavior; server exportVersion is 1.
deterministicFindings.runtimeLimit: No file import, server creation, or actual malformed CTI request sent.

deterministicFindings.title: A cold paused inventory is rendered as a successful empty list and unknown counts appear as zero
deterministicFindings.mechanism: With no retained data, no fatal error and fetchStatus=paused, query.isLoading is false while DataState remains initial/isRefreshBlocked. Root items defaults to []; no error/loading branch applies, so workspace chooses No automations yet. StaleRefreshWarning suppresses no-data sources. Workspace always renders Showing 0 and an active filter badge can render 0 / 0 even during unresolved or fatal state.
deterministicFindings.sourceConfirmedEffect: The source branch conflates unresolved inventory with measured empty inventory; brief correctly displays Rules unavailable, producing inconsistent trust on the same page.
deterministicFindings.followUpScope: AutomationsListPage only: distinguish not-yet-resolved/paused from successful []; gate shown/total captions on established data and provide truthful source recovery. Preserve independent gallery/comfort and retained rules.
deterministicFindings.runtimeLimit: No browser offline transition performed; conditional branch was read, not executed.

deterministicFindings.title: Malformed successful collection responses are either masked as empty or crash list computation
deterministicFindings.mechanism: safeArray converts null or non-array bodies to [] without a query error, making an invalid inventory look successfully empty; array elements are not validated, so [null] reaches computeStats and a.auto_disabled throws. selectPinned only applies nullish fallback, not Array.isArray, so an object body reaches automationPins.forEach. These selectors do not supply fail-closed source error/recovery.
deterministicFindings.sourceConfirmedEffect: The stated invalid-input paths are visible directly in source; no claim that current backend emits them. Valid empty arrays retain their intended meaning.
deterministicFindings.followUpScope: Coordinate a scoped automation-list/pin response validator with their existing hook owners; do not globally rewrite safeArray or loosen typed contracts. Preserve retained valid data and source-specific retry.
deterministicFindings.runtimeLimit: No invalid payload injection or render test run.
